integrity: Analytic proof with explicit finite reproducibility checker; mathematical independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform-arclength unit-circle samples only, deterministic target tending to circle center, radial critical scale and larger-vanishing-radius Gaussian scale; general nonsymmetric densities and random targets are unproved. The c=0 spectral law is known. Full texts of two high-relevance historical studies remain inaccessible and priority is provisional.
title: A noncentral-to-Gaussian transition for simplicial depth near the center of a circle
